fields.source_title: Andhra Pradesh High Court PIL against Google-Adani Visakhapatnam data centre (notice issued 1 Jul 2026)
fields.summary: A public-interest petition in the Andhra Pradesh High Court questions the project's Environmental Clearance and the allotment of 160 acres of land. The court issued notice on 1 July 2026. Reuters reports the court listed the PIL for 24 Aug 2026 and that the state told it care is being taken within the law. Outcome pending.

records.verbatim: The high court had issued notice on the PIL on July 1.
records.notes: Probe HIT. Petitioner per secondary coverage is environmental activist Bolisetty Satyanarayana (name not on the probed page, so not in the record). Scope sentence is on the same page: 'questioning the project's Environmental Clearance and the allotment of 160 acres of land for the project'. Pass-1 claim that the court let the developer proceed 'at its own risk' is NOT verified and is dropped. Land-plot identity (temple land at Adavivaram and Mudasarlova, not Tarluvada or Rambilli, per the page) is recorded in notes only.

fields.source_title: Bar & Bench — NGT seeks Centre's response to plea against clearance for Google-Adani's Rs 17,700 crore Vizag data centre
fields.summary: The National Green Tribunal has sought the Centre's response to an appeal challenging the environmental clearance for the Visakhapatnam data-centre project. Secondary coverage names the appellant as former GVMC corporator Boddu Ganga Rao and the clearance as one granted 10 Jun 2026 to Vizag Hyperscale Data Centre Park Ltd (Adani Infra SPV); the appeal alleges the site is about 750 m from Kambalakonda Wildlife Sanctuary and was wrongly classed B2. Next hearing reported as 26 Oct 2026.

records.verbatim: has sought the Central government's response to a plea challenging the environmental clearance
records.notes: Probe HIT. date is the Bar & Bench report date (16 Oct 2026); the NGT order date is not on the page, so date_is_event is false. Appellant name, 10 Jun 2026 clearance date and 750 m distance come from a secondary search summary, not the probed page: verify the NGT record before shipping. Cluster-level: the appeal is against one SPV's clearance, not the whole 2.51 GW. Pass-1 Human Rights Forum NGT petitions are a different claim; Guardian reports them (see leads).

TNW (secondary) reports, citing the Guardian, that clearance covers 2.51GW against the 1GW announced, granted in nine days with no public hearing, and that 520 families lost land given about 20 years ago. Find the Guardian URL, then probe its exact sentences. Verbatim on TNW (not a valid source): '2.51GW of capacity, more than double the 1GW announced, according to clearance papers seen by the Guardian'. Note the TNW page (26 Sep 2026) also says the Human Rights Forum filed three NGT petitions.

Google first-party: the Google India blog index (blog.google/intl/en-in/) was fetched and has no Visakhapatnam post. The Google claims available in primary form are the Adani/AdaniConneX release quotes (Thomas Kurian, Gautam Adani) in ADANI_PDF. Google's own blog post on the AI hub is still unlocated; try blog.google search for 'Visakhapatnam' or the Google India press page.

Pass-1 records to drop or re-cite: the Human Rights Forum response (in-resp-tarluvada-ec-2026-04-18) cites 'Clearances (ECs) granted on 18 April 2026' by SEIAA. The NGT record above gives the 10 Jun 2026 clearance to the Adani SPV. Reconcile both before shipping.

Visakhapatnam water: Reuters (via NST) says government says city receives 410 MLD against 480 MLD need, per Green Visakha's statistics. Not probed as a verbatim here; the figure is from the Reuters body text and needs a probe pass on the same NST page before a response record.

Human Rights Forum (humanrightsforum.org) statement on content restrictions: Instagram restricted a HRF post on 31 May 2026 about a petition on the Visakhapatnam data centres. Primary HRF page found in search (humanrightsforum.org/?p=13980); not probed. Use only as a response about the petition, not as a fact about the project.

AP High Court PIL: hearing dates conflict across outlets (notice 1 Jul 2026 per LiveLaw-type page; Reuters says next hearing 24 Aug 2026; a Sept 2026 report says the court adjourned and directed the state to obtain all clearances before construction). Pull the court order for the actual dates before a second response record. The 'developer proceeds at its own risk' claim in pass 1 is not verified.

Tarluvada forest status: an opinion piece republished by Countercurrents and Human Rights Forum says hill cutting is underway in Pedda Chukka Konda reserve forest; a Reuters piece says one site is a few metres from a reserve forest. Not verified. Check the forest diversion record.

Other AP allotments mentioned in search (unverified, secondary, undated): Adani Enterprises 130 acres Madhurawada for a 200 MW park (Rs 14,634 crore); Sify Infinit Spaces 25 more acres (July 2026, second phase of 500 MW). Find AP G.O. numbers on the AP government portal before writing any policy record.

DCD returned 403 on probe. Needs the court's status or a primary news page with a probe-able verbatim.
